t-shirt.definition: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.

hoodie.definition: A sweatshirt with an attached hood.

pants.definition: Clothing covering the body from the waist down with a separate part for each leg; American English for trousers.

khakis.definition: Casual trousers made from khaki-colored fabric.

capris.definition: Trousers that end below the knee but above the ankle.

coat.definition: An outer garment worn over other clothes for warmth or protection.

fleece.definition: A soft warm garment made from fleece fabric.

dress.definition: A one-piece garment with an upper section and a skirt.

jumpsuit.definition: A one-piece garment combining a top and trousers.

romper.definition: A one-piece outfit combining a top and shorts.

uniform.definition: Standard clothing worn by members of an organization or profession.

undershirt.definition: A shirt worn under other clothing, next to the skin.

sneakers.definition: Casual or athletic shoes with flexible rubber soles.

stilettos.definition: Shoes with tall, very thin heels.

slides.definition: Open-back sandals with a strap or band across the foot.

wedges.definition: Shoes with a sole that forms a continuous wedge beneath the heel and foot.

clogs.definition: Shoes with thick rigid soles, traditionally made of wood.

mules.definition: Shoes with closed fronts and open backs.

dress-shirt.definition: A smart collared shirt worn with formal or business clothing.

cocktail-dress.definition: A smart dress worn for semi-formal social events.

cardigan.definition: A knitted garment that opens at the front and is worn over other clothes.

uniform.definition: Standard clothing worn by members of an organization or profession.

hard-hat.definition: A rigid protective helmet worn at a work site.

gloves.definition: Hand coverings worn for protection while working.
